author: MarioNawfal
text:
🇨🇳🇺🇸🇮🇷 Pepe Escobar: Xi just handed Trump an off-ramp from the Iran war.

The most important part of the Trump-Xi summit may have had nothing to do with tariffs or AI.

Escobar says Xi Jinping directly raised the Strait of Hormuz with Trump and pushed Washington back toward the abandoned U.S.-Iran memorandum of understanding.

“It’s your off-ramp. There’s no other off-ramp.”

The emerging formula, according to Escobar, is straightforward but extremely difficult:

Iran gradually reopens Hormuz while the U.S. simultaneously ends its blockade and releases Iranian funds. Tehran, he says, will not move first and simply trust Washington to follow.

That creates the interesting part.

Someone would have to guarantee both sides move together.

Escobar’s answer is China.

He says Beijing and Tehran coordinated closely before the UN meetings, with Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi and Wang Yi meeting twice, while China’s position remains that Washington should return to the previous MOU.

If that reading is right, China is no longer  watching the Iran crisis from the sidelines.

@RealPepeEscobar
